preconditions.description: Input is a single integer n representing the number of vertices in the complete undirected graph, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 300.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 4 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for v in line.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n²) representing the number of cycles, followed by k lines each describing a cycle of length 3 or 4 with vertices in the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle must be simple (no repeated vertices except the first and last).

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()[1:]) == int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle must have exactly m vertices where m is the declared length (3 or 4).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 4 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for v in line.split()[1:])) and (stdout.strip() != '-1' or (all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 4 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for v in line.split()[1:])))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must describe a valid set of cycles covering all edges exactly twice in a complete graph with n vertices.
